description: Synthetic: product codes of every length a receipt prints: EAN-13, EAN-8, a 12-digit EAN with its check digit cut off, and a 4-digit PLU on a weighed line.
notes: Receipt-level case: invented data and no source. Use `fixture.expected` directly, e.g. for catalog matching by EAN.

`ean` is kept exactly as printed (4 to 14 digits). Only the 13-digit code carries a valid GS1 check digit; the 12-digit one is the same code as the first line minus its last digit, so a matcher that wants to join them has to account for that.
A 4-digit PLU (`4011`, loose bananas) identifies a produce type, not a product; the weighed line has no unit price.
